title: 5 Filters to Hear God Clearly
hook: Want to hear God more clearly? Run what you sense through these 5 filters.
script: Want to hear God more clearly? Run what you sense through these 5 filters. First, does it align with Scripture? God won’t contradict His Word—2 Timothy 3:16. Second, does it draw you to Christlike character? My sheep hear My voice—John 10:27. Third, does it plant peace instead of panic? Let Christ’s peace rule—Colossians 3:15. Fourth, do wise believers affirm it? There is safety in counsel—Proverbs 11:14. Fifth, does good fruit show up over time? You’ll know by their fruit—Matthew 7:16. For the next 48 hours, journal impressions, sit quietly with Psalm 62, and test them. God isn’t hiding from you.

title: When God Feels Silent: Try These Checks
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. I used to chase signs and second‑guess everything. Then I learned five simple checks. If it clashes with Scripture, it isn’t Him. If it makes you look more like Jesus, lean in. If it bullies you with panic, pause; His peace guides, not pressure. Ask two mature believers to weigh it; wisdom protects. Then wait and watch the fruit; truth ages well. Tonight, get still with Psalm 62 for five minutes, journal what you sense, and don’t act for 48 hours. Test it again. God’s voice is steady, and He loves to lead you.

title: Stop Overthinking: 5 Tests for God’s Voice
script: You may be overthinking this. God’s voice is simple, not noisy. Ask five yes-or-no questions. Does this agree with Scripture? 2 Timothy 3:16. Does it sound like the Shepherd and form Christ in me? John 10:27. Does it settle me with peace, not rush me with fear? Colossians 3:15. Do trusted believers confirm it? Proverbs 11:14. Does good fruit appear as I wait? Matthew 7:16. Try a 48‑hour experiment: sit quietly with Psalm 62, journal what you sense, don’t post or decide, then recheck these questions. Save this for your next decision. God is not playing hide-and-seek.
